change: Only unwrap a complete single lowercase json Markdown fence before the same strict JSON parser. Do not extract mixed text, repair values, remove fields or relax any planner/teacher/reviewer content contract.
study_role: All eight cases in this rerun are exploratory. Parser repair was motivated by already observed outputs; no prospective or independent outcome claim.
offline_rejudge: Reparse first two saved turns and separately check content. The old reviewer was prompted with an unparsed draft; do not treat its old text as a real review of the recovered draft.
metrics: JSON parse rate separately from role-content validity
interpretation: A wrapper becoming parseable is not a successful role result. Incorrect student status, extra fields, unsupported text and contradictory review remain failures.
